content.title: AIG to acquire minority stakes in Convex Group and Onex Corporation
content.summary: AIG intends to obtain a 35% equity stake in Convex Group for around $2.1bn, as well as a 9.9% stake in Onex Corporation for about $646m.

thumbnail.caption: AIG also plans to commit $2bn over three years to a range of Onex investment funds with preferred access. Credit: T. Schneider/Shutterstock.com.
